_help: This file controls which PDI universe feeds each column of the deck, and what the columns are called on the slides. To change a universe (e.g. after the June primary), edit the 'universe' value and the 'label', save, done. 'alternates' are also accepted if the file uses one of them instead — handy during transitions. Do not change the 'id' values: total, near, far are wired to the template.
